name: Market-neutral momentum/low-vol portfolio
description: W6 portfolio construction: long the top 15 and short the bottom 15 by qc_mom_lowvol_liq, inverse-volatility weighted, beta-neutral, max 10% per name, 30% per sector. Without a shortable instrument the book cannot be neutral, so new longs are held back (NEUTRALITY_UNAVAILABLE) unless allow_long_only is set.
